data.name: Ihsaan
data.gender_notes: Ihsaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: To do a good deed with sincerity and generosity, to do it beautifully, and to be kind and forgiving when faced with adversity. The name Ihsaan carries the meaning “Excellence, Grace, Beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ihsaan usually hope their child will grow to embody excellence, grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A state of inner peace and contentment, achieved by striving to do good deeds and be kind to others
data.etymology: Ihsaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Excellence, Grace, Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ihsaan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إحسان
in_arabic.meaning: إحسان تعني الإحسان إلى الآخرين والإجادة في الأفعال
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإحسان هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الإحسان إلى الآخرين والإجادة في الأفعال، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، قال تعالى: "وليضاع لهم الحسنة"، وقد وردت أيضًا في الحديث النبوي الشريف: "الإحسان أن تعبد الله كأنك تراه".

in_urdu.name: احسان
in_urdu.meaning: احسان کا مطلب ہے حسن سلوک اور اچھائی کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: احسان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حسن سلوک اور اچھائی کرنا، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور حدیث نبوی شریف میں بھی اس کا ذکر ہے، مسلمانوں میں یہ نام حسن اور اچھائی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इहसान
in_hindi.meaning: इहसान का अर्थ है दूसरों के साथ अच्छा व्यवहार करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इहसान एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है दूसरों के साथ अच्छा व्यवहार करना और अच्छे काम करना, यह नाम कुरआन माजिद में आया है और हदीस नबवी शरीफ में भी इसका उल्लेख है, मुसलमानों में यह नाम अच्छाई और सज्जनता का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: احسان
in_pashto.meaning: احسان د نورو سره د ښه چلند معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: احسان د عربي نوم څخه دی چې د نورو سره د ښه چلند او د ښه کارونو معنی لري، دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې راغلی او په حدیث نبوي شریف کې هم ددی ذکر دی، په مسلمانانو کې دا نوم د نیکۍ او سجیلت نښه ده.

in_english.name: Ihsaan
in_english.meaning: Ihsaan means to do good deeds and behave kindly
in_english.long_meaning: Ihsaan is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ḥ-s-n', meaning to do good deeds and behave kindly. It is mentioned in the Quran and Hadith, signifying excellence in actions and benevolence. The name embodies virtues of kindness, generosity, and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The Arabic word "Ihsaan" (إحسان) is often translated as "excellence," "goodness," or "acting compassionately towards others." In Islamic culture, it refers to an act of worship, or a good deed that is performed with sincerity, generosity, and elegance. Over time, the term "Ihsaan" has become a reminder for Muslims to strive for excellence in all aspects of life, whether it be in their daily actions, business dealings, or interactions with others. It's a call to be kind and compassionate in everything that we do, and to always aim for the highest standard, both for ourselves and for others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Ihsaan" holds deep meaning as it's related to God's love and mercy towards human beings. It's a reminder of the importance of having a good intention and a sincere heart when performing any deed, as it's not just the physical act that pleases God, but the heart's intention behind it. By focusing on performing acts of Ihsaan, Muslims can connect more deeply with their faith, and strive to increase their closeness to Allah, the Almighty. It also teaches us the importance of being kind, forgiving, and generous to those around us, essentially representing the best of human nature.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Excellence, Grace, Beauty" symbolizes To do a good deed with sincerity and generosity, to do it beautifully, and to be kind and forgiving when faced with adversity. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ihsaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of excellence, grace, beauty.
